title: 车值8500美元：四年付了近13000美元，贷款却展期到2029年？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I needed the car because I had just moved from Columbus, Ohio to Cleveland, Ohio and I had to find a car in order for my kids to get back up for the school.
segments.zh: 我需要车，因为我刚从俄亥俄州哥伦布搬到克利夫兰，得找辆车送孩子回学校。

segments.en: I purchased the car in February of 2022 and the original finance mount was for $12,173.
segments.zh: 我在2022年2月买了这辆车，原始融资金额是12173美元。

segments.en: By November of that year, Jamie had fallen behind on her payments and was contemplating bankruptcy, but her lender offered her another way out.
segments.zh: 到那年11月，杰米已经拖欠还款，考虑申请破产，但贷款机构给了她另一条出路。

segments.en: Baker's read something off saying that this would go on the back into the loan and that they have to send me something.
segments.zh: 贝克念了一些内容，说这会被加到贷款后面，他们得给我寄些东西。

segments.en: Yeah, it was like that was the only option that I had.
segments.zh: 是的，那好像是我唯一的选择。

segments.en: Over the next 28 months, Exeter modified her loan four times.
segments.zh: 在接下来的28个月里，埃克塞特修改了她的贷款四次。

segments.en: Ultimately pushing her repayment schedule all the way to February 2029.
segments.zh: 最终将她的还款计划一直推到了2029年2月。

segments.en: And literally when I came in the house to shower and change clothes and when I went to run back out the door to go to my second drive, my car was gone.
segments.zh: 当我进屋洗澡换衣服，准备跑出门去开第二趟车时，我的车不见了。

segments.en: I don't know why because I had been behind a month before and they didn't repossess it. I'm not sure.
segments.zh: 我不知道为什么，因为之前我拖欠了一个月，他们也没有收回车。我不确定。

segments.en: After having paid nearly $13,000 over four years for a car that was only worth $8,500 when she first bought it.
segments.zh: 四年间她为这辆车支付了近13000美元，而当初买时它只值8500美元。

segments.en: Bloomberg News analyzed nearly three million US auto loans that were packaged into subprime asset back securities issued between 2021 and 2023.
segments.zh: 彭博新闻分析了近300万笔美国汽车贷款，这些贷款在2021至2023年间被打包成次级资产支持证券。
